towns.name: Sanamar Royal Hall
towns.summary: The Royal Hall of King Varicci II (gazetteer 'Sanamar Palace', 70.0N 62.5W) overlooks Sanamar from a high rocky promontory at z 80 with the sea on three sides, 570 m south-west of the city - the chapter climax of Sanamar. A square curtain wall (x 9408-9552, y 41160-41304) of grey stone with gold-roofed four-storey corner towers and a twin archway north gate encloses the palace proper: four red-domed 21/22-storey halls rising to 163.6 m (84 m above the cliff) and two 12-storey domed towers (134.6 m), home of the king, the Grand Knight of the Ordina Rossu Morta and the Rossu Morta Chapterhouse and Viamontian Torture Chamber portals. A destroyed portal to Redspire (a dark crystal) stands on the ridge to the north-east. Filmed as its own site from the Royal Hall teleport.
